exercises.question: How do «por una parte … por otra parte», «cabe destacar que» and «en síntesis» structure the closing statement of a mediation transcript?
options: The first pair balances reciprocal concessions, the second highlights a decisive breakthrough, and the third condenses the agreed outcome
All three expressions introduce counterfactual wishes that require the imperfect subjunctive in the subordinate clause that follows
The first expression introduces a formal objection, while the second automatically cancels all previous clauses of the preliminary agreement
The three expressions function as casual spoken fillers used to interrupt the other delegation during an informal bargaining round

exercises.question: Complete the balanced summary of the pact: «Por una parte, la dirección garantiza la inversión; por _____ parte, la plantilla retira la convocatoria de huelga.»
options: otra
otro
esa
estas

exercises.sentence: Las dos delegaciones se comprometieron por escrito a acatar el _____ que dictara el órgano de arbitraje.
exercises.english: Both delegations committed in writing to abide by the official ruling issued by the arbitration body.

exercises.sentence: En definitiva, el tono conciliador de la reunión permitió firmar el acta de avenencia y dirimir las dudas mediante un arbitraje independiente.
options: Sign the formal settlement record and resolve the doubts through independent arbitration
Reject the formal settlement record and resolve the doubts through independent arbitration
Sign the formal settlement record and postpone the doubts through independent arbitration
Sign the formal settlement record and resolve the doubts without independent arbitration

exercises.question: According to Elena Vargas in paragraph 2 of the transcript, what would have happened if the cultural commission had not interceded to open the moratorium?
options: Both sides would be facing a costly legal dispute today
The cultural centre would have closed its doors permanently in May
The municipal council would have dismissed the technical staff without notice
The workshops would have been relocated to a private building outside the city

exercises.question: What specific condition does Martín Soler offer in paragraph 3 regarding weekend working hours?
options: To make weekend shifts more flexible so that no technician exceeds thirty-six hours a week
To eliminate all weekend performances during the winter season
To pay triple overtime for every hour worked after ten o'clock on Thursdays
To hire twelve external technicians so resident staff only work mornings

exercises.question: Why does Martín Soler ask for a joint monitoring committee in paragraph 5?
options: So that both sides can verify the works each month and renegotiate minor deadlines if a supply contingency arises
So that the management board can veto any electrical repair that costs more than sixty per cent of the budget
So that an external judge can fine technicians who arrive late on Thursday evenings
So that the assembly can rewrite the entire pact from scratch every three weeks

prompt.speaker: Delegada
prompt.text: Hemos revisado ya todos los anexos del pacto. ¿Cómo resumiría usted el resultado de esta jornada para el acta?

options: En síntesis, hemos logrado reconciliar las dos posturas; además, cabe destacar que el nuevo pacto garantiza la paz laboral.
En síntesis, hemos logrado reconciliar las dos posturas; además, cabe destacar que el nuevo pacto garantice la paz laboral.
Por una parte, hemos logrado reconciliar las dos posturas; por otro, cabe destacar que el nuevo pacto garantiza la paz laboral.
En síntesis, hemos logrado reconciliar las dos posturas; además, cabe destacar de que el nuevo pacto garantiza la paz laboral.

exercises.english: Ultimately, it is worth highlighting that the formal settlement made it possible to reconcile the two sides.

exercises.question: Which adjective best describes an attitude focused on restoring harmony and reaching mutual understanding in mediation?
options: conciliadora
intransigente
estancada
costosa
